hero.pitch: Co-founder of Scale Labs and Full Stack developer at Universidad de la Costa. I build complete web platforms, from the API to the interface, with React, Laravel and Django, plus automations that improve real processes.

about.title: Building with purpose
about.p1: I'm a Full Stack developer with 3+ years of experience, a Software Analysis and Development Technologist from SENA, and currently studying Systems Engineering at UNAD. Today I'm co-founder of Scale Labs, where we build custom software, and a Full Stack developer at Universidad de la Costa CUC.
about.p2: I've worked across the whole development cycle: interface design in Figma, frontends in React and Angular, backends in PHP/Laravel and Python/Django, MySQL and Firebase databases, and automation with Apps Script and AppSheet.

items.desc: Co-founder of a custom software development company. We design, build and scale platforms, management systems, automations and AI integrations for businesses that need to grow without losing what already works.

items.org: Universidad de la Costa CUC · Barranquilla
items.desc: Full Stack development of applications and systems for the university, from the backend and APIs to the user interface.

Dynamic, responsive interfaces with React, reusable components, performance optimization and REST API integration, working in Scrum teams from UI/UX designs. Latest project: the Invermax Inmobiliaria website.

Requirements analysis, interface design, frontend development and testing in multidisciplinary teams. Built an interactive occupational health and safety risk map with real-time visualization, and a contractor activity planner that improved tracking and resource allocation.

items.org: Universidad Nacional Abierta y a Distancia — UNAD
items.desc: Undergraduate degree in Systems Engineering, complementing professional experience with a solid foundation in software engineering, architecture and project management.
Training in software engineering, databases, web and mobile development. Academic projects including an inventory system, an e-commerce app and a Nequi clone in Kotlin.
